heading: What our customers say
intro: Guests book Ceylon JOJO Travels for private chauffeur guides, clear day plans, and flexible multi day routes across Sri Lanka. Below are sample guest comments. You can also browse our TripAdvisor profile for the full rating history.
ratingNote: TripAdvisor rating 5.0 from verified travellers. Private tours for couples, families, and small groups.
r1.quote: Excellent private driver guide. Punctual, careful on mountain roads, and patient at temples and photo stops. Our Ella and Yala days felt well paced.
r1.author: Sarah M.
r2.quote: We wanted a private car, not a big bus. Communication on WhatsApp was easy, hotels matched what we booked, and the Temple of the Tooth visit was smooth.
r2.author: James & Anna
r3.quote: Sigiriya day tour with hotel pickup worked perfectly. Our guide explained timings and helped with tickets. Highly recommend for first time visitors.
r3.author: Laura P.
r4.quote: Family friendly pacing, clean vehicle, and flexible lunch stops. Yala safari was the highlight. We will book again for the south coast.
r4.author: The Nguyen family
cta: Planning a private Sri Lanka tour? Message us on WhatsApp with dates and group size.
